parts.text: Research engineering role developing the perception and augmented-vision engine for ImmersaXR on standalone XR devices. Work includes 3D geometry, object recognition, pose estimation, markerless tracking, video/depth processing and real-time integration with Unity, C#/C++, OpenXR and Android XR. The 12-month contract targets a TRL 4 demonstrator. Requires computer vision, embedded systems and software engineering experience. The CNRS lists a January 2027 start and an 8 December 2026 application deadline; the regional listing explicitly dates publication to 17 November 2026. Ref. UMR9015-JEAVEZ-002.
